Aisha: Flight diverted, ETA airport -> +3h10m. I need to hand primary for 08:30-12:00 UTC. Can someone pick up primary or do a split? @Ben @Carlos @Dana
Ben: I can take primary but I9m in a standup until 08:45 UTC. If Carlos can shadow first ~15m that9d be great. Will confirm infra tokens before taking pages.
Carlos: I9ll shadow 08:30-08:45 and handle any immediate pagers. Ben, I can forward any urgent logs to you while you9re in standup.
Dana: I9ll be secondary for the whole window and enable pager->phone. Aisha, can you drop the quick handoff checklist and the runbook link?
Aisha: Quick context: we had a p95 embeds spike earlier (now cleared), no ongoing customer impact. Handoff checklist below:
- Post current alerts + mitigation state
- Confirm PD/rotation swap so pages route correctly
- Share runbook link + key commands
- Who9s owning active playbooks (if any)
Runbook: https://redwood.work/runbooks/oncall-handbook
Recent pager excerpt: incident-bot @ 07:58 UTC: "embeds-p95 spike -> autoscaler throttled -> model fallback triggered" 10:04 UTC resolved.
Ben: Do I need to update Console routing, or is PD swap enough for page delivery?
Aisha: PD swap is sufficient for page delivery. Console routing stays; if you see sustained token growth > 1.5k QPS, follow fallback policy to rdm-sm-compact-v1. Check Console > Models > Fallbacks. Also keep an eye on kv_cache_hit_rate metric. If <55% and qps high, fallback churn increases.
Carlos: FYI I checked the embeds service logs: no deploys in last 2h, KV cache hit ~73% trending down slowly, autoscaler headroom at ~40%.
Dana: I9ve enabled pager-forward to my phone and set escalation to eng-sre on second consecutive page per playbook. I9ll update #oncall-status once swap complete.
Aisha: Executing PD swap now:
/pd swap --from @Aisha --to @Ben --secondary @Dana --until 2024-06-05T12:00:00Z
incident-bot: [08:31 UTC] PD swap recorded: primary=@Ben secondary=@Dana until 2024-06-05T12:00:00Z
Ben: Confirmed PD invite and alerts. My phone is on. I9ll post a two-line runbook summary when I9m fully primary.
Carlos: Shadowing started 08:30. Quick checks: logs (grep model_fallback), kv cache snapshot, autoscaler metrics. No active alerts.
Dana: PD swap visible, pager forwarding confirmed. Escalation rules set.
Ben: Took primary at 08:45. Summary: monitors green, no active alerts; fallback thresholds default. If page fires, follow playbook: step 1 triage, step 2 engage eng-sre on second page within 15m, step 3 open incident channel if customer impact.
Aisha: Thanks everyone. I9ll be offline til ~12:10 UTC, DM me if something urgent but don9t wait on me. Appreciate the cover.
Carlos: GL on the travel. I9ll drop a short handoff note when you9re back.
Dana: I9ll close the loop in #oncall-status once Aisha confirms back on primary.
incident-bot: [12:06 UTC] User @Aisha back online - handback noted.
Aisha: Back online 12:09 UTC. Confirmed handback and removed PD swap. Thanks team :heart:
